test_coverage_notes: This code is low-level coroutine infrastructure. Direct unit tests for Coro are unlikely; instead, coverage is expected via higher-level JobQueue and job/coroutine scheduling tests. Validation code (XRPL_ASSERT, debug checks) is only active in debug builds, so release builds do not check finished_ state. Test files likely to cover this indirectly include those for JobQueue, job scheduling, and possibly integration tests for asynchronous job handling. Gaps: No direct tests for validation logic (e.g., destructor assertion, expectEarlyExit), and no explicit tests for race conditions or invalid coroutine state.
